loyaltyProgramEnrollment.description: Event fired when a user enrolls in or updates their loyalty program status, capturing their current loyalty tier.

user.description: Object containing user identity and loyalty program tier attributes used across travel booking transactions.

Booking Completion.description: Event fired when a user completes a travel booking transaction, capturing booking details, transaction information, and user loyalty status.

transaction.description: Object containing booking and transaction details including items, pricing, currency, affiliations, and unique transaction identifier.
